concepts.prompt: Tight real macro phone photo, low angle, of a plus-size woman's foot and ankle on sunny theme-park pavement in the black-purple shoe: the stretch-knit upper and grid pattern fill about 55% of the frame, sharp, her capri leggings and a blurred crowd and generic castle behind in warm late-afternoon light. Headline in white Poppins ExtraBold on the soft blurred upper area, two lines the same size: "Support that stretches" "when your feet swell." Under it one white Poppins SemiBold line: "Hour 1 to hour 12 of a park day." At the bottom a small white line with an arrow: "See why Denise wore them all 3 days →". FONT: every typeset word is Poppins (ExtraBold headlines, SemiBold labels): wide, round, geometric letters, never condensed (no Bebas, Anton, Oswald, Impact), never script. Photographic parts look like genuine phone photos, NOT AI: natural uneven light, real skin and fabric texture, slight grain, imperfect framing. TEXT RULE: all text black, deep navy or white with strong contrast, never purple or other colored words (an accent color may only fill a solid pill or bar behind white text); every line of the headline is the same size and weight; labels share one large uniform size (at least 1/25 of the canvas height). The plus-size woman is shown warmly and respectfully: real body, flattering everyday clothes, confident, never as a joke or a 'before' shot. The shoe is the exact shoe from the reference photo, large, sharp, true natural proportions, never compressed or tiny. No Disney characters, logos, mouse ears or trademarks; the park is a generic sunny theme park. No icon badges, no buttons, no star ratings, no other text than quoted.
